description: Filaire de voirie - Toulouse Métropole is a dataset listed in Data Toulouse Metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Toulouse Métropole. Filaire de voirie de Toulouse Métropole. Coverage: Toulouse Métropole. The portal files it under Territoire. Its keywords are voie, transport, referentiel, circulation, deplacement, adresse. The portal shows 33,685 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-11-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-toulouse-metropole-fr-portal.
